instruction: Pick up the orange sponge and place it on the clear table area B, right of its starting position in the frontal view. Approximate destination pixels in the full 1920x1080 images: c922 [895,917], usb [731,776]. Use the table surface and keep away from the electronics and the table edge.

steps.help: The jaws push the sponge away instead of closing on it. Move it a bit closer to the arm or turn it so its thin side faces the jaws.

verdicts.reason: Grasp failed: orange sponge remains unmoved on table edge in usb_before vs usb_after, and c922_after shows blue gripper open and empty above the table. Jaws closed too high / on air, so lower gripper further onto sponge before closing.

plan.destination: clear table area B on the table surface, to the right of the orange sponge starting position in the frontal view, away from electronics and table edge
